International Scholarships

Lincoln recognises academic achievements of international students.

International Flagship Scholarships

Tuition rebate after 12 or more weeks of English for Academic Purposes.

  • NZ$2,500 for the Pathway Certificate or First Year Pathway Diploma. Details
  • NZ$3,000 for undergraduate degrees with academic requirements.
  • NZ$5,000 for a Bachelor's degree with academic requirements.
  • NZ$10,000 undergraduate credit.
  • Automatic master's awards of NZ$15,000, NZ$10,000 and NZ$7,000 for taught master's students with an A or B+ average.
